name: Marukon
source:
Main character leads a normal life until the day he picks an object from the devil world off the road.
He starts to have mischief with the girls around him, and bizarre incidents start to happen one after another. Fate makes him travel to the devil world with different girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公过着普通生活，直到有一天从路边捡起一件来自魔界的物品。
他开始对身边的女孩恶作剧，诡异事件接连发生。命运让他与不同女孩一起前往魔界。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
